instruction.text: Add 1 more doll to the image.
instruction.sound: There are 2 dolls in the image. Add another doll by selecting the empty space on the right.

instruction.text: How many dolls can you see?
instruction.sound: Count the dolls in the image. How many dolls are there altogether now?

trainers.finishSound: ssml: Well done! Two dolls<break time='100ms'/> plus one doll <break time='100ms'/> equals three dolls.

instruction.text: Add 1 pair of scissors to the image.
instruction.sound: There are 4 pairs of scissors in the image. Add another pair by selecting the empty space on the right.

instruction.text: How many pairs of scissors can you see?
instruction.sound: Now count all the pairs of scissors in the image again. How many of them can you see?

trainers.finishSound: ssml: Correct! Four pairs of scissors <break time='100ms'/> plus one more pair<break time='100ms'/> equals five pairs of scissors.

instruction.text: Add 1 more bag to the image.
instruction.sound: There are 5 bags in the image. Add another one by selecting the empty space on the right.

instruction.text: How many bags can you see?
instruction.sound: How many bags are there altogether now?

trainers.finishSound: ssml: Super! Five bags<break time='100ms'/> plus one bag<break time='100ms'/> equals six bags.

instruction.text: Add 1 more sock to the image.
instruction.sound: One more time! There are 7 socks in the image. Add another one by selecting the empty space on the right.

instruction.text: How many socks can you see?
instruction.sound: How many socks are there altogether now?

trainers.finishSound: ssml: Very good! Seven socks <break time='100ms'/> plus one sock <break time='100ms'/> equals eight socks. Brilliant!
